description: Turn an OpenAPI or GraphQL API into a governed MCP server with code mode, ops tools and evals that score how well agents use it.
rules: Each server/environment has its own stateless MCP endpoint: /mcp/{server}/{env}; every server has a built-in mock environment.
Configuration: environment variables plus an optional neurouter.yaml (see neurouter.example.yaml); `npx neurouter validate` checks it.
Local development uses SQLite; production uses Postgres with pgvector.
